title: Sheartune
description: Shear tune is a mod where you get more wool out of your shears with an enchantment called shear tune, aka the mod name. It's not op, but rather a balanced enchantment giving you more wool, just not an insane amount of it. Made by Woafool and FractalGoose
body:
Sheartune is a mod that adds an enchantment that you put on shears to get more wool for those sheep farms you have or, simply just wanting to get all the colored beds for some reason. This mod is a balanced mod meaning that you still get a decent amount of wool for what enchantment it is. Theres three enchantments, sheartune I, sheartune II, and sheartune III. Each enchantment giving you a little more wool as you enchant. But with sheartune III you can get up to 5 pieces of wool!! (thats a lot of blocks). Like i said, this is a balanced mod with nothing too big, just giving you more wool for those grindy times where you need it.

CREDITS creators of mod: Woafool creator and mod maker, FractalGoose, publisher.
